elements_selected.content: Implement the no-index graceful fallback (REQ-072). Before opening the TUI: check for the existence of .zetl/index.json (or equivalent per SPEC-006). If missing: display a status message 'Building index…' on stderr (before entering alternate screen); run the SPEC-006 index pipeline in-process (call the same function as 'zetl index'); if indexing succeeds, proceed to open the TUI; if indexing fails, exit non-zero with a plain-text error and JSON error code INDEX_BUILD_FAILED. REQ-072, CON-023.
